content_data.meeting_title: Data-Driven University Initiative: Initial Research Pilot Planning
agenda_items: Allocation of preliminary research tasks and responsibilities
Identification of key research questions for the pilot phase
Review of proposed data sources from energy industry partners
key_decisions: Formulate a joint university-industry data governance committee for oversight and dispute resolution.
Prioritize real-time sensor data from smart grid infrastructure for initial pilot due to high impact potential.
action_items: Ms. Patel (Research Assistant): Compile a literature review on recent advancements in AI for energy grid optimization within the next 2 weeks.
Dr. Sharma (Computer Science): Schedule a follow-up meeting with industry legal counsel to discuss data anonymization strategies within the next 10 days.
